Dear New Car Rental Team,

I am writing to inquire whether you provide child seats for your rental vehicles. Could you please let me know if this service is available and any associated costs or requirements?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech

final_text:
I've sent an inquiry to New Car Rental's support address (support@newcarrental.co.uk) based on the customer review that mentioned this email address. The email asks specifically about child seat availability, associated costs, and any requirements.

The inquiry has been successfully sent (email ID: 1) and I'm now waiting for their response. Once I receive their reply, I'll be able to provide you with the information about whether they have child seats available.

In the meantime, I can also check other aspects of New Car Rental if you'd like - such as their rating, reviews, car types available
